topic: Classifying animals by body parts and use
key_concepts: Animals can be classified by body parts and how they move
Some animals walk or run using their legs
Some animals hop or jump using their legs
Some animals fly using their wings
Some animals swim using fins and tail
Some animals crawl using their legs
Fish use gills to breathe underwater
Common body coverings include hair, fur, scales, feathers, and shells
Dogs, cows, goats, horses, carabaos, pigs, and cats use legs for walking or running
Birds, butterflies, bees, houseflies, dragonflies, and fireflies use wings to fly
Crocodiles, sharks, frogs, and most fish use fins and tails for swimming
Lizards, spiders, crocodiles, and turtles use legs for crawling
